decks.notes: The main concept behind this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient burn spells while utilizing aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to chip away at their life total quickly. With a low mana curve and plenty of direct damage spells, the deck aims to close out games swiftly before the opponent can stabilize or gain control of the board. The deck also includes cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack to protect its creatures and prevent the opponent from gaining life, ensuring a steady stream of damage to finish off the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly and aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while generating value with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. It aims to close out the game quickly with creatures and burn spells like Terminate and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Undying Malice, creating a constant threat to the opponent's resources. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also disrupt the opponent's mana base, further increasing the deck's aggressive edge.

By using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers, this deck aims to control the game by continuously disrupting the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of the companion Kaheera provides additional synergy and value to the deck. The primary win condition is to establish board control and outvalue the opponent over time, leading to a victory through incremental advantage. The deck prioritizes maintaining a stable mana base to consistently cast its spells and effectively manage the opponent's threats.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Orcish Bowmasters. Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recursion, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate help control the board. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to further its aggressive game plan. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a unique companion that adds consistency to the deck.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana. The deck utilizes control elements such as Karn, the Great Creator, Oblivion Stone, and Relic of Progenitus to manage the board and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to stabilize the game early on, find key pieces with Ancient Stirrings and Sylvan Scrying, and eventually close out the game with powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also utilizes The One Ring and Urza's Saga to further enhance its game plan.

The focus of this deck is to quickly deploy efficient threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan with a mix of burn spells, card selection, and counterspells. By leveraging powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent alongside efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the board. The inclusion of cards like Expressive Iteration and Preordain helps to smooth out the deck's draws and ensure consistency in applying pressure and disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize, while utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply pressure early on in the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with threats, as well as cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Orcish Bowmasters to support the aggressive strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death to protect and enhance its creatures, creating a fast-paced and disruptive playstyle.

This deck aims to aggressively play Death's Shadow as quickly as possible, using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtseize to manipulate both players' decks and reduce life total efficiently. It also includes various removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect its threats. Additionally, it utilizes cards like Expressive Iteration and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck's overall strategy is to deal damage quickly and efficiently while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to remove threats, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and control the pace of the game. With a mix of efficient creatures and powerful removal spells, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively before the opponent can stabilize.

The main idea of this UrzaTron control deck is to assemble the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Tower, and Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This allows the deck to play powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes various ways to search for and protect the Urza lands, as well as disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus. Ultimately, the goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent with efficient threats and powerful control elements.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently using cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking, Amulet of Vigor, and Primeval Titan to combo off and generate a significant amount of mana to cast powerful threats like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Cultivator Colossus. The deck also utilizes lands like Urza's Saga and The Mycosynth Gardens to further accelerate its game plan and create an overwhelming board presence. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with massive threats and powerful interactions.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing a mix of efficient creatures and powerful spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional consistency and flexibility. The main deck features a diverse mana base to support a variety of color requirements, as well as a mix of removal spells and pump effects to push through damage. Overall, the key idea behind this deck is to apply pressure from the beginning and maintain a constant stream of threats to close out the game swiftly.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf while disrupting the opponent with a suite of targeted discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to deal with opposing threats. Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recurring value, while the inclusion of Mishra's Research Desk and Pyrite Spellbomb offers additional utility and reach. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain control of the board throughout the game.

The main concept of this Modern Combo - Hammer Time deck is to assemble the powerful combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to quickly equip creatures with huge power and evasion. Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift help tutor for key pieces while Inkmoth Nexus provides an alternate win condition. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga and Emeria's Call for additional value and card advantage. Giver of Runes provides protection for your key creatures, allowing you to quickly overwhelm your opponent with explosive attacks.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards through discard effects like Cathartic Reunion and Thrilling Discovery, allowing for powerful graveyard-based synergies and activations. Cards like Darkblast and Creeping Chill benefit from having cards in the graveyard, while Golgari Thug and Narcomoeba help to put even more cards into the graveyard. Once the graveyard is filled, the deck can generate value and aggression with cards like Prized Amalgam and Ox of Agonas. The deck also utilizes lands like Gemstone Mine and City of Brass to manage its color requirements.

The main concept of this Red Deck Wins deck is to be aggressive and burn the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. The deck utilizes low-cost, high-damage cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Rift Bolt, along with creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to apply pressure early on. Additional cards like Boros Charm and Skewer the Critics provide versatility and reach. The mana base is optimized for fast and consistent gameplay, with cards like Sunbaked Canyon and Roiling Vortex adding card advantage and extra damage.
